claims.statement: Current insurance applications request detailed evidence about EDR, MFA, backups, vulnerability testing, and related controls, making missing-control remediation and application completion observable work.

Organizations purchasing cyber insurance allocate IT and risk labor to these controls, and Marsh says some controls are minimum insurer requirements; willingness of Polish SMEs to pay a separate readiness fee is unknown.
A plausible control path is a nonexclusive agreement with a licensed broker that accepts standardized evidence, with an insurer-neutral standalone pack as fallback; no agreement is secured.
The broker application-preparation page explicitly advises involving IT expertise and lists security-control information needed for quotation, supporting a serviceable coordination gap.

commercial_mechanics.budget_owner: Owner, CFO, IT manager, risk lead, or insurance buyer
commercial_mechanics.bundling_resistance: Vendor-neutral evidence reuse, fixed scope, Polish-language remediation, and multi-broker portability must beat free pre-quote scans
commercial_mechanics.customer_relationship_owner: The broker owns insurance placement; the venture would own only its readiness-service relationship if contracted
commercial_mechanics.distribution_origin: Licensed insurance broker, MSP, accountant, lender, or contract-compliance adviser

fully_loaded_economics.acquisition_cost: Channel revenue share, MSP enablement, and targeted SME outreach
fully_loaded_economics.cash_conversion: Deposit or full prepayment for readiness; referral revenue arrives only after licensed placement
fully_loaded_economics.contribution_margin: Service-like until collection and checks are automated; remediation scope creep can erase margin
fully_loaded_economics.delivery_and_support_costs: Customer interviews, control verification, exception management, and broker handoff
fully_loaded_economics.overhead_and_compliance: Security, professional liability, regulatory advice on insurance distribution, GDPR, and quality assurance
fully_loaded_economics.revenue_basis: Target 2,500-7,500 PLN per readiness sprint plus 500-2,000 PLN annual refresh; any referral compensation only where lawful
fully_loaded_economics.variable_costs: External scans, evidence collection, remediation subcontractors, report review, and payment fees

commercial_mechanics.likely_incumbent_response: Brokers, insurers, MSPs, security vendors, and risk-scanning platforms can bundle readiness and active monitoring
commercial_mechanics.paid_event_or_measurable_loss: A verified readiness pack is paid; measurable loss is remediation labor, delayed or declined quotation, adverse terms, and uncovered cyber loss exposure
commercial_mechanics.payer: SME purchasing readiness work; possibly licensed broker or insurer for a compliant referral after placement
commercial_mechanics.purchase_trigger: New policy application, renewal questionnaire, customer cyber clause, lender request, or broker-identified control gap
commercial_mechanics.renewal_event: Annual policy renewal and evidence refresh after material IT changes

contrary_evidence: Insurers and brokers increasingly bundle scans, control guidance, and proactive services with insurance.
The cited underwriting forms are international, not proof of identical Polish underwriting criteria.
An MSP already managing the customer's stack may produce the evidence more cheaply.

critical_control_point.counterparty_refusal_fallback: Sell a standalone control-evidence pack through MSPs and let customers choose any licensed broker
critical_control_point.customer_relationship_owner: The broker owns insurance placement; the venture would own only its readiness-service relationship if contracted
critical_control_point.founder_access_description: Public underwriting forms and lawful outreach to SMEs, MSPs, and licensed brokers are available; no distribution appointment, client evidence, or insurer data is held
critical_control_point.launch_controller: A licensed Polish broker or insurer; none selected
critical_control_point.renewal: Proposed annual partner renewal tied to policy cycles
critical_control_point.subject: Cyber-insurance quotation and policy-placement relationship

economics.acquisition_route: Licensed brokers, MSPs, accountants, lenders, and contractual cyber-compliance referrals
economics.founder_net_worth_path: Conditional path: 1,000 annual sprints and refreshes at a 3,500 PLN blend equals 3.5m PLN revenue; software-assisted delivery and broker distribution could create value above 5m PLN, but regulatory access and demand are unproven
economics.founder_time: A standardized ten-client pilot can fit 3-5 hours daily if remediation is referred out
economics.gross_margin_basis: Service fee less scanning, reviewer labor, remediation partner cost, acquisition share, insurance, and compliance
economics.payback: Could pay back through faster quotation or avoided duplicated consulting, but premium or coverage improvement is not established
economics.pricing: Discovery hypothesis: 2,500-7,500 PLN readiness sprint, 500-2,000 PLN annual refresh, and only legally permitted channel compensation
economics.retention_or_repeat: Annual refresh around renewals plus material IT changes

fingerprint.compounding_advantage: Permissioned mapping of evidence gaps to underwriting questions, remediation time, and quote outcomes improves triage
fingerprint.customer: Polish SMEs seeking first-time or renewed cyber insurance without an internal security team
fingerprint.distribution_mechanism: Nonexclusive broker, MSP, accountant, and lender referrals
fingerprint.offer_and_business_model: Fixed-price control verification and remediation coordination linked to licensed broker quotation, without carrying insurance risk
fingerprint.payer_and_paid_event: The SME pays for a completed readiness evidence pack; a licensed channel may separately pay a lawful referral or distribution fee after policy placement
fingerprint.problem_trigger: A broker questionnaire, renewal, customer-contract requirement, lender condition, or rejected cyber-insurance submission

founder_fit: Evidence scoring, questionnaire normalization, and quote-outcome analysis fit data-science and finance interests
A fixed-scope asynchronous sprint can operate alongside employment
Broker and MSP channels reduce dependence on continuous founder networking or video content
The founder need not carry insurance risk and can measure gap closure, turnaround, and placement outcomes
risks: Accidentally conducting regulated insurance intermediation without authorization
Security evidence itself is sensitive and attractive to attackers
Clients may misconstrue readiness as a guarantee of coverage or security
Channel partners can internalize the workflow after learning it

structural_signature.commercial_model_descriptor: fee based risk readiness service linked to licensed cyber insurance placement
structural_signature.control_point_descriptor: pre underwriting evidence handoff into a broker or insurer quotation route
structural_signature.critical_dependency_descriptor: insurer risk capacity and licensed broker willingness to quote and bind qualifying smes

structure.commercial_archetype: Risk-transfer enablement service with licensed insurance distribution partner
structure.control_point: Broker or insurer distribution access at pre-underwriting readiness
structure.critical_dependency: Licensed brokers and insurers willing to accept the evidence pack and quote qualifying SMEs

thesis: Observed underwriting-workflow signal: current cyber-insurance application forms ask detailed questions about MFA, EDR, backups, restoration tests, patching, and incident response, while brokers say some controls have become minimum insurability requirements. Sell Polish SMEs a fixed-scope evidence sprint that verifies answers, closes bounded gaps through partners, and hands a reusable evidence pack to a licensed insurance broker for quotation.
title: Controls-to-Cyber-Insurance Readiness Route
uncertainties: Polish insurance-distribution licensing boundary for referrals, quotation assistance, and compensation
Broker willingness to accept third-party evidence and share outcome data
SME readiness budget and remediation conversion rate
Liability when a verified control later fails
